title: The Reunion — EN/ES/FR (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 100bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal life philosophy Spanish French language learning Perth Zimbabwe
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The school reunion happens every ten years give or take
And the mathematics of who's aged how is the first mistake
You make — looking too hard at the calculus of the face
And forgetting that the room is not a competition for the grace

[Verse 2 — Spanish, with English translation]
La reunión escolar ocurre cada diez años más o menos
[The school reunion happens every ten years give or take]
Y las matemáticas de quién ha envejecido cómo son los frenos
[And the mathematics of who's aged how are the brakes]
Miras demasiado la aritmética de los rostros
[You look too hard at the arithmetic of faces]
Y olvidas que la sala no es una competición de nuestros]
[And forget that the room is not a competition of ours]

[Chorus — English]
The reunion knows something I don't know
It knows that thirty years is both very long and not the show
The reunion gathers everyone who shared the same coordinates
For three years in the eighties and calls them schoolmates
That's my boy

[Bridge — French, with English translation]
La réunion scolaire a lieu tous les dix ans environ
[The school reunion happens every ten years or so]
Et les mathématiques de qui a vieilli comment sont les prisons
[And the mathematics of who aged how are the prisons]
Tu regardes trop l'arithmétique des visages
[You look too hard at the arithmetic of faces]
Et tu oublies que la salle n'est pas un podium ni un passage
[And forget that the room is not a podium nor a passage]

[Outro — All three languages]
Reunion knows… La reunión sabe… La réunion sait
Time was the same for everyone — El tiempo fue igual para todos — Le temps a été le même pour tous
That's my boy
